correctness.rationale: Independently derive the two-coset right-translation character fiber B_chi=[[r,t],[conj(t),conj(r)]], r=chi(a)+chi(b), t=chi(c)+chi(d). B*B eigenvalues (|r|+|t|)^2 and (|r|-|t|)^2. Odd order excludes individual r/t zero and |1+chi(u)|=|1+chi(v)| iff chi(u-v)=1 or chi(u+v)=1; annihilator inclusion-exclusion gives exact nullity. In F_p^d the equal/opposite, dependent-nonopposite, and independent cases give N,N/p,2N/p-N/p^2; unoriented difference pair counting yields all census coefficients. Surjectivity of pair character values and monotone consecutive cosine gaps yield smallest positive difference 2(1-cos(pi/p)) and four root-pairs each with p^(d-2) preimages. Independent calculation verified nullities and gaps for p=3,5,7, including middle stratum p=5; supplied package checker inspected and uses true right-convolution matrices, not just saved logs.

value.rationale: The exact arithmetic obstruction to invertibility for natural smallest balanced nontrivial two-coset supports and the sharp visible-space conditioning quantify which information is recoverable and its sensitivity. The three geometric classes and exact complete census genuinely distinguish dependency structures; the quadratic-in-p sharp endpoint is a motivated natural invariant beyond simply writing a generic Fourier block matrix. A general downstream theorem is not required.

final_claim: For an odd-order finite abelian group A and unweighted two-plus-two right convolution on A semidirect C2 by inversion, the complete singular spectrum and character-annihilator nullity are exact; on A=F_p^d there are precisely three geometric nullity classes and support counts, and independent differences have sharp least positive singular value 2(1-cos(pi/p)) with multiplicity 4p^(d-2).
limitations: Right convolution unnormalized on odd abelian inversion extension only; prime elementary classification needs p odd,d>=2; independent gap requires linearly independent differences.
